title: My HOA fined me $250 for plowing the sidewalks without "written approval"
lines: My HOA fined me two hundred and fifty dollars for plowing the sidewalks without written approval.
Every winter I clear our whole street with my old plow truck. Nobody asks. Nobody pays. I just like doing it.
Then a letter showed up. Unapproved snow removal. Fine attached.
Two nights later, we got two feet of snow.
I cleared my driveway. Only my driveway.
By eight a.m., the street looked like a glacier.
The HOA president couldn't get his car out. Neither could anyone coming to his meeting.
That afternoon, another letter appeared under my door.
And underneath, in pen: please start with my driveway.
I did. Right after everyone else's.
